answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in ridge, expire in marble, and ferrous lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 127 aliases therefore needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3457 identities would post 1989 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
